title: Send project messages
responsibility: Run project chat requests and prepare reviewable feature plans from committed Harness contracts.

inputs.name: projectAgentActions.agent
inputs.description: The current project conversation and bridge allowed to send its requests.

inputs.name: projectAgentActions.draft
inputs.description: Selected Plan, Ask or Change mode, message and exact discovered model.

inputs.name: projectAgentComment.agent
inputs.description: The conversation and verified comment permission of the selected project.

inputs.name: projectAgentComment.text
inputs.description: Human comment to save at the entity or project revision currently in view.

outputs.name: projectAgentActions
outputs.description: Ask and Change use the selected project runner. Plan asks a read-only planner to use committed Harness contracts and metadata, with the overall goal and shared feature TLDR first; it returns affected pages, exact committed current/wanted image references and partial-edit regions, parent relationships and complete wanted contracts. The bridge generates and commits page design options and the unapproved plan. No implementation tasks run before the user chooses designs and approves the exact plan digest.

outputs.name: projectAgentComment
outputs.description: True after saving the human comment; false if permission or saving fails.

errors.name: planning unavailable or stale
errors.description: Rejects when the selected project, writable source revision, bridge capability or exact reference changes during plan preparation.

errors.name: invalid planner response
errors.description: Rejects malformed plan JSON, incomplete wanted contracts, missing affected-page references or a mismatched source revision before tasks are created.

errors.name: projectAgentComment save failure
errors.description: Reports a denied or failed comment without changing the conversation.
